Dr. Fei-Fei Li, The Godmother of AI — Asking Audacious Questions, Civilizational Technology, and Finding Your North Star (#839) Leave a comment

Dr. Fei-Fei Li (@drfeifei) is the inaugural Sequoia Professor in the Computer Science Department at Stanford University, a founding co-director of Stanford’s Human-Centered AI Institute, and the co-founder and CEO of World Labs, a generative AI company focusing on Spatial Intelligence. Dr. Li served as the director of Stanford’s AI Lab from 2013 to 2018. She was vice president at Google and Chief Scientist of AI/ML at Google Cloud during her sabbatical from Stanford in 2017/2018.

She has served as a board member or advisor in various public and private companies and at the White House and United Nations. Dr. Li earned her BA in physics from Princeton in 1999 and her PhD in electrical engineering from the California Institute of Technology (Caltech) in 2005. She is the author of The Worlds I See: Curiosity, Exploration, and Discovery at the Dawn of AI, her memoir and one of Barack Obama’s recommended books on AI and a Financial Times best book of 2023.

Listen to this episode on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Overcast, Podcast Addict, Pocket Casts, Castbox, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Audible, or on your favorite podcast platform.

World Labs | Stanford | Twitter | LinkedIn

"Really, at the end of the day, people are at the heart of everything. People made AI, people will be using AI, people will be impacted by AI, and people should have a say in AI."— Dr. Fei-Fei Li

"It turned out what physics taught me was not just the math and physics. It was really this passion to ask audacious questions."— Dr. Fei-Fei Li

"We're all students of history. One thing I actually don't like about the telling of scientific history is there's too much focus on single genius."— Dr. Fei-Fei Li

"AI is absolutely a civilizational technology. I define civilizational technology in the sense that, because of the power of this technology, it'll have—or [is] already having—a profound impact in the economic, social, cultural, political, downstream effects of our society."— Dr. Fei-Fei Li

"I believe humanity is the only species that builds civilizations. Animals build colonies or herds, but we build civilizations, and we build civilizations because we want to be better and better."— Dr. Fei-Fei Li

"What is your North Star?"— Dr. Fei-Fei Li

“AI 教母”李飞飞博士——提出大胆的问题、文明级别的技术，以及寻找你的北极星（第 839 期）发表评论

李飞飞博士（@drfeifei）是斯坦福大学计算机科学系首任红杉讲席教授，斯坦福以人为本 AI 研究院的联合创始联席主任，也是 World Labs 的联合创始人兼 CEO。World Labs 是一家专注于空间智能（Spatial Intelligence）的生成式 AI 公司。2013 至 2018 年，李博士担任斯坦福人工智能实验室主任。2017/2018 年她在斯坦福大学休假期间，担任 Google 副总裁兼 Google Cloud AI/ML 首席科学家。

她曾在多家上市公司和私营企业、白宫以及联合国担任董事会成员或顾问。李博士 1999 年获普林斯顿大学物理学学士学位，2005 年获加州理工学院（Caltech）电气工程博士学位。她是 *The Worlds I See: Curiosity, Exploration, and Discovery at the Dawn of AI* 一书的作者，这本回忆录也是 Barack Obama 推荐的 AI 主题书籍之一，并入选 2023 年《金融时报》年度最佳图书。

你可以在 Apple Podcasts、Spotify、Overcast、Podcast Addict、Pocket Casts、Castbox、YouTube Music、Amazon Music、Audible 或你喜欢的播客平台上收听本期节目。

“说到底，人是一切的核心。人类创造了 AI，人类将使用 AI，人类将受 AI 影响，而人类也理应对 AI 有发言权。”——李飞飞博士

“事实证明，物理学教给我的不仅仅是数学和物理本身，更是一种敢于提出大胆问题的热情。”——李飞飞博士

“我们都是历史的学生。其实我并不喜欢科学史的某种讲法，那就是过分聚焦于单个天才。”——李飞飞博士

“AI 绝对是一项文明级别的技术。我将文明级技术定义为：由于其力量，它将会——或者说已经——对我们的经济、社会、文化、政治以及整个社会的下游效应产生深远影响。”——李飞飞博士

“我相信人类是唯一会建立文明的物种。动物会建立群落或兽群，但我们建立文明，而且我们建立文明是因为我们想要越来越好。”——李飞飞博士

“你的北极星是什么？”——李飞飞博士
